dashboard.signInDescription: Access to this dashboard requires authentication. Choose how you’d like to sign in.

add.title: Add your first product
add.body: Click here. Snap a photo — the AI drafts the title, description and price for you.

bulk.title: …or import a whole box
bulk.body: Have a batch of items? Point your camera at each one — a draft product is created per photo.

connect.title: Connect your Stripe account
connect.body: Click here to link your own Stripe — customers pay directly into it, and it unlocks Tap to Pay in the POS app.

welcome.title: Welcome to your catalogue
welcome.body: This is your store's control room — add and edit products, import in bulk, and see how the store is doing. Here's a 30-second tour.

addProduct.title: Add a product
addProduct.body: Add a single item by hand — name, price, category, photo, and description. The AI can draft the description for you.

csvImport.title: Import in bulk
csvImport.body: Already have a spreadsheet? Import your whole catalogue at once with CSV, and use Bulk Photo Upload to attach images.

autoTranslate.title: Let AI fill the gaps
autoTranslate.body: Auto-Translate and Re-Categorise use AI to complete missing English copy and sort products into the right category — you review before anything is applied.

connectStripe.title: Get paid directly
connectStripe.body: Connect your own Stripe account so your storefront's customers pay straight into it. Until you do, checkout falls back to a manual flow.

insights.title: See what's working
insights.body: Insights summarises your orders and revenue so you can spot your best sellers. That's the tour — you can replay it anytime.

claimAdmin.title: Claim your store
claimAdmin.body: Sign in so this account becomes the store's admin.

brandStore.title: Add your branding
brandStore.body: Upload your logo and pick your brand color — the storefront themes itself from these.

firstProduct.title: Add your first product
firstProduct.body: Snap a photo and let the AI draft the description, or import a CSV of your catalog.
firstProduct.migrateBody: Export your items as CSV from your {{provider}} dashboard and upload it on the Import page — you review every item before anything is written.
firstProduct.stripeBody: Once your Stripe account is connected (the payments step below), one click on the Import page brings your products across.

connectStripe.title: Connect payments
connectStripe.body: Link your Stripe account to accept cards online and TWINT / Tap to Pay at the market.
connectStripe.migrateBody: Link the Stripe account you already have — your checkout keeps working, and it unlocks the one-click catalogue import above.

firstAiPhoto.title: Style a product photo with AI
firstAiPhoto.body: Turn one phone photo into a clean catalogue shot — included with your plan.

inviteStaff.title: Invite your team
inviteStaff.body_one: Your plan includes {{count}} staff seat — invite a teammate to run the register.
inviteStaff.body_other: Your plan includes {{count}} staff seats — invite a teammate to run the register.

customDomain.title: Set up your custom domain
customDomain.body: Serve the store on your own domain with managed HTTPS.

posReady.title: Take a card payment on your phone
posReady.body: Install the Zolto POS app and sign in with your POS key — the first card sale finishes the setup automatically.
